structure:
Part 13, "ins address book: add, edit, view and delete a record": the specs under tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book that change or show one record, read in full with their page objects, flows, domain constants, fixtures and utils.

Read in full: the ten specs address-book-add-type.spec.ts (8 tests), address-book-add-roles.spec.ts (4 tests, run three times by a loop over the three role-backed address types, so 12 at run time), address-book-add-form.spec.ts (4 tests), address-book-edit.spec.ts (18 tests across its top level and the nested describes "opened without a return", "opened from the dashboard", "dead links" and "an address whose stored country is not offered"), address-book-view.spec.ts (7 tests across its top level and the nested "return" and "dead links" describes), address-book-delete.spec.ts (9 tests across its top level and the nested "return" and "dead links" describes), address-book-validation-messages.spec.ts (3 tests), address-book-add-handshake-guard.spec.ts (1 test), address-book-add-germinal-products-handshake.spec.ts (1 test) and address-book.spec.ts (1 test); the local helpers unknown-address-id.ts, expected-api-refusal.ts, expect-address-book-list.ts and expect-other-organisation-address-returns-to-list.ts; the page objects add-page.ts, form-page.ts, shared-form-fields.ts, address-type-page.ts, edit-page.ts, view-page.ts, delete-page.ts, record-page.ts, url-with-return.ts, list-page.ts, shared/base-page.ts, shared/opens-at-expected-url.ts, shared/summary-list.ts and shared/govuk-banners.ts; the domain constants address-form.ts, address-book-types.ts, address-book-journey.ts, trader-address.ts, address-details.ts, shared/address-types.ts, shared/test-record-names.ts and the DB model address-document.ts; flows/ins/journey.ts and flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts; fixtures/ui.ts; utils/roles-options-assertions.ts and utils/address-book-cleanup.ts.

Covered: the add journey as an ordered sequence (the address book list's Add a new address button, the Choose an address type step, then the add-details form with the roles question), each step's route, caption, heading, fields, options, hints, buttons and links; the four address types with their labels and hints and the at-least-one refusal; the roles question's three per-type legends, its hint, its per-type options and its refusal; the nine details fields in order with County present and marked optional; every validation message the specs assert, on the add form, the edit form and the address book API; the view page's summary rows with and without the two optional fields and its Edit and Delete actions; the edit page's fields, read-only absence of the roles question, whole-record replacement and role retention; the delete page's heading, summary, copy, buttons, tombstoning and refusals; every dead-link and stale-record case for edit, view and delete, the return allow-list, organisation scoping; the add hand-off guard for an unregistered journey type and the germinal-products hand-off's own route, controls and return; and one gap where three validation messages the INS form's own constants hold are asserted nowhere in this slice.

Stops at the list, tabs, filter and roles-listing specs (part 12) and the animals-side hand-off specs (part 7); the roles question a journey-reached add form asks (journeyRolesQuestion in address-book-types.ts) is asserted only by the animals-side specs and is left to part 7.

The partition's counts for four of the ten specs no longer match the repo: it expects 23 tests in address-book-edit.spec.ts (18 today), 12 in address-book-view.spec.ts (7), 11 in address-book-delete.spec.ts (9), 5 in address-book-add-roles.spec.ts (4 literal declarations, 12 at run time), 4 in address-book-validation-messages.spec.ts (3) and 3 in each of the two hand-off specs (1 each). Every test present today is claimed.
